scope: Official-source review of creative, productivity and scientific desktop software; editorial fit assessments, not hands-on benchmarks.
known_review_gaps: MusicBee and ocenaudio are not labeled open source: their detailed publisher license terms need direct confirmation.
Maintenance activity was established from dated upstream feeds where available; other records retain an unverified maintenance status.
No application was installed or benchmarked during this documentation review.
method: Public official websites, project READMEs, upstream license files, install/download pages, and GitHub commit Atom feeds were fetched over HTTPS. HTTP success is recorded separately from runtime validation. Download links point to official landing pages rather than unverified version-pinned binaries.

corrections.reason: The old domain returned a parked/domain-sale page; upstream README identifies celestiaproject.space.
Current project homepage identifies helge17/tuxguitar as the continued project repository.
Official README explicitly identifies www.orcaslicer.com and warns about other similarly named domains.
